newsitem.title: INDIA: DELHI SHARES END FLAT, PROFIT-TAKING ERASES GAINS.
newsitem.headline: DELHI SHARES END FLAT, PROFIT-TAKING ERASES GAINS.

text.p: Profit-taking by speculators and domestic financial institutions against a slowdown in foreign buying wiped out early gains as Delhi share prices closed virtually unchanged on Thursday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index ended 0.87 point lower at 943.30. The index had been up 6.68 points at 950.85 in the afternoon.
